lesson: If GUI operations fail repeatedly, prefer using code-based approaches with libraries like openpyxl or pandas instead
Always modify existing open files IN PLACE - never create new files unless explicitly required
Use openpyxl or pandas for in-place modifications of Excel files
Perform COMPLETE OVERWRITES, not appends - replace all content/sheets/paragraphs
Check screenshot context to identify which file is currently open before modifying
NEVER modify headers, titles, sheet names, or structural elements unless explicitly requested by the user
Maintain fonts, colors, borders, formatting, styles, and table positioning when modifying data
Only change content/data, not visual presentation or structure
